purpose: Finish manual take choice and reversible retakes using accepted immutable candidates; no UI redesign or paid calls.
factory: Add selectTake(command:SelectTakeCommand, routeShotId?:string):Promise<{selection:TakeSelection,changed:boolean}> to existing createProductionTakeService, add selectionPOST to createMediaRouteHandlers; route.ts exports POST only.
rules: No trusted billing resolver or provider request is needed to select/clear local media.
Validate project and immutable command shot ownership/stable route shotId before any action.

nonnull take must match exact current compatible selected shot, completed job/result/asset/receipt pins and muted provider-audio policy; require latest genuine take approval for computeTakeApprovalHash, plus existing current anchor/story/animatic eligibility.

Verify selected take asset bytes outside TX. Capture exact relevant current eligibility fingerprint and latest take approval IDs/hash before await, reread/compare in TX. Drift rejects409/no pointer change.
Require expectedSelectionVersion equal current project-global takeSelectionVersion; any stale expected version409, even if pointer happens to match.

If requested pointer already equals current and expected version current, return unchanged selection changed:false. Else existing compareAndSetSelectedTake atomic CAS, then return updated selection changed:true.
null clears only the mutable pointer, preserving all take/anchor/approval/job history. Clearing a project-owned historical shot is allowed even if no longer current; never erase history.
No automatic selection upon approval/generation, no new job/approval/model calls, no resetting existing takes.
Same-origin strict bounded64KiB selection POST200/no-store, sanitized existing error envelopes.
minimal_checks: One real temporary SQLite/vault flow: select approved candidate, retake sibling retained, manually switch, stale CAS rejects without change, null clear and reselect retained original.
One existing fixture variation or minimal HTTP flow proving missing/rejected/stale approval or async context drift never changes pointer; preserve old media/history.
Focused owned takes test/typecheck/diffcheck only; comprehensive coverage/build deferred.
